I did not find, in these excerpts, any provision addressing exclusion of consequential/punitive damages or similar "excluded losses" language, so I cannot answer that broader version of the question from the material given.

runs.question: Under the original RevMed-Sanofi agreement, what happens to rights and obligations that arose before the deal ended?
runs.answer: The excerpts do not directly address survival of pre-termination rights and obligations in general terms, but they do specify what happens to accrued rights/obligations upon termination or expiration. Under the general effects-of-termination provision, "all rights and obligations of the Parties under this Agreement with respect to such Product or country shall cease except as otherwise set forth in this Section 12.3 or elsewhere in this Agreement," and termination or expiration with respect to one Product or country does not affect the Parties' rights and obligations with respect to other Products or countries [doc-001, p. 60, §12.3]. Additionally, licenses and rights granted to Sanofi generally terminate and revert to RevMed upon the specified terminations, "except as necessary to permit Sanofi to perform its surviving obligations under this Article XII" [doc-001, p. 60, §12.3]; [doc-001, p. 64, §12].
